songs.album: A Rush of Blood to the Head

Wave of You

songs.name: Dancing Queen

songs.name: jar of hearts
songs.comments: Definitely a bit repetitive

songs.name: Hallelujah
Love Somebody
songs.comments: A little repetitive. I generally like the sections and how they transition into each other so I didn't deduct from flow.
Has the same kind of strange choppy back and forth feeling as believer. I dislike it but that might be just preference. I also don't like the bridge.

songs.name: Do Ya
幸福就是

songs.comments: That voice is unbelievable, especially at the end after the key change. So hauntingly beautiful. No clear problems with any other part of the song. I might actually prefer the live version though

songs.comments: The line "show me your tits" doesn't quite fit with the feel of the song in my opinion. Aside from that the lyrics are a little repetitive. I'm not sure about the vocal score, there's nothing technically impressive but the quality of his voice is very soothing.

songs.comments: Chorus makes up too much of the song I feel. The timbre of his voice is incredible though. It blends well with the background vocals and the guitar.

songs.comments: The "la biblioteca donde está" line in the middle is incredibly odd.

Lovely Day

songs.comments: I don't like some parts of the vocals (you can hear a lot of breath and air) but it's hard to deny that he's a very good singer. Lots of unique lyrics and the translation looks good. This song probably deserves a higher score.
songs.name: End of a day

songs.comments: Could just be my headphones but the bass sounds so high and weak on this. Lyrics are pretty inspirational but the line "my father told me" isn't impactful enough for the place it's in
songs.name: The Nights
Feel Good Inc.
songs.comments: The way he forces out the last "ha" always stood out to me, not sure if I like it or I don't but it is interesting. The song almost feels unfinished, it feels like there should be another verse to me.

Putting different parts on different sides has an interesting effect but it does feel a bit lacking in the left ear. The lyrics sound poetic but are a bit nonsensical. I'm tempted to increase the vocal score because his voice has such a unique quality.
songs.name: The Crystal Ship

songs.comments: Lyrics are repetitive and crass but vocals are good. Bridge is pretty meh.
songs.name: Beep Beep
Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go
songs.comments: Maybe a little repetitive. Vocals in some spots are definitely better but not throughout the whole song. Cohesion and background at the end are better but also not throughout.
I like the bridge a lot
songs.name: Back In The U.S.S.R. - Remastered 2009

songs.comments: I'm a little biased with this song admittedly. I really like the line starting with "you reach your hand to hold me." The energy of the song increases throughout. One of the best implementations of having different parts in different ears.
songs.name: Moonlight Drive
'39 - Remastered 2011
songs.album: A Night At The Opera (Deluxe Remastered Version)

songs.name: When I Was Your Man
songs.comments: Bridge is outstanding and the final chorus concludes the song well. Some of the sections have vocals that are so unique and flawless I can't begin to imagine executing them. The section between "I was wrong" and "Oh, I know" is genuinely mind blowing.

songs.name: The Box
songs.comments: The "ee er" in the background sounds pretty funny. I don't love the autotune but the vocals are pretty good. Chorus is a bit repetitive. So is the background.

songs.name: Starman - 2012 Remaster
songs.album: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars (2012 Remaster)

songs.comments: The song clearly builds throughout. Some really nice lyrics in here like "this all-consuming fire fuming" but also some weaker ones like "what's going on" which doesn't sound right.
songs.name: Bewitched
Believer
songs.comments: Small nitpick, I don't like the overlap of the word pain between "heartache from the pain" to the chorus. Instrumental is very basic until the end and I kind of just don't like the sudden back and forth motion between the chorus and the verses.

songs.name: Crazy Little Thing Called Love - Remastered 2011
Stereo Hearts (feat. Adam Levine)
songs.comments: A huge portion of the song is dominated by choruses but all of the parts transition into each other pretty well so I didn't deduct.
I didn't deduct too much from the lyrics or flow despite the extreme repetition because he varies the way he sings them throughout.

Live And Let Die
songs.comments: The structure is pretty abysmal. It just repeats the pre-chorus and chorus once and in between there's a section that doesn't feel like it fits with the song at all. The instrumental break also doesn't feel like it fits. A bit disappointing because the intro is great.
The peak in the second verse is incredible. Main criticism is how often the chorus repeats, especially at the end. Just not a very strong ending.
songs.name: Butterflies

songs.comments: The background does build. I still would've preferred some new lyrics and a bit more of a climax.
songs.name: 味道

songs.comments: Lyrics are a little basic but I didn't deduct. I deducted from flow because it was a bit repetitive and I didn't like how it just ended on another chorus.

songs.comments: Gun violence is a serious topic but I can't help but find some of the lyrics to be extremely funny. Chorus is a little repetitive, transition out of the instrumental is a bit sudden and the outro doesn't conclude very well.
songs.name: Put Out The Fire - Remastered 2011
Perfect
songs.comments: I like how all the repeated verses have slightly different lyrics. Lyrics are a little cheesy.
Reduced flow score because the song seems to meander a bit towards the end.

songs.comments: Maybe a few too many repeats of "getting to the point." Lyrics generally are pretty good though.

Redbone

songs.name: Sweet Talkin' Woman
songs.comments: The vast majority of the song is composed of choruses or pre-choruses. There's an unnaturally sharp cut between "no, no, no" and "don't know what I'm gonna do" the first time.

songs.name: Sorry Not Sorry
songs.comments: Not a lot going on in the background. Vocals are hard to place because they stick out so much it's a bit grating but she has good technique and range. I found it a bit repetitive.
It's not quite as bad as it looks but having "ooh" be pretty much the only lyric in the second half isn't great.
songs.album: The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 And Beyond
songs.name: Safe & Sound - from The Hunger Games Soundtrack

songs.comments: Instrumental is amazing. Not sure if I like the refrain, it interrupts the flow of the song and suddenly drops the energy. I think her vocals could've used just a bit more energy and emotion. Not a lot in the lyrics. An outro would be nice.
songs.name: 4:00A.M.
the words
songs.comments: Flow is barely passable. There is building in the background and some variation but still the chorus is repetitive.

The song actually builds well to the climax. There's a consistent motion throughout the song too. Everything fits together really well during the peaks at the chorus. The repeated sections have their differences too. Bridge is also good.
songs.name: Enchanted
Under Pressure - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Overall a pretty odd song with some really good parts. A little all over the place between the scatting, switching singers and different sections. Very hard to score any part of this song.
As I'm noticing with many songs, the lyrics fall off in the second half. The slight variations in execution help a bit.
songs.name: Saturday Night’s Alright (For Fighting) - Remastered 2014

songs.comments: I'm not a fan of this structure rap songs use where they feature an artist to do the repetitive chorus and do all the distinct verses. This is a slightly better example. This one actually follows a consistent theme.

songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit repetitive but the delivery is different.
songs.name: Gloria
Talking to the Moon
songs.comments: I feel that during the climax of the song the instrumental gets so overwhelming that it takes away the solemn vibe from the start of the song

songs.name: comethru
songs.comments: Might just be a preference but I really don't like these vocals. I don't like how some parts just suddenly cut off and it doesn't sound very well supported. I don't like how the song builds as if it's going to climax then just drops.
Slightly repetitive chorus
songs.name: Take Me to Church

songs.comments: I think the choruses get a little louder each time but it's not super obvious. There's a bit of movement in the background too but I still feel it's not quite enough. It's debatable whether or not the flow score should've been lowered.
songs.name: Rolling in the Deep

songs.comments: Intro is very good. Some lyrics like "golden eagle" and "queen of hearts" feel a bit random because they don't seem to be connected to one theme. The chorus feels a bit out of place. Background, lyrics and cohesion could be scored lower.
songs.name: Past Lives

songs.comments: Very few unique lyrics on this one. A lot of "ooh" and "ahh." The lyrics that are there are pretty good though. The choruses are literally identical though.
songs.name: Home

songs.name: Careless Talk

songs.name: The Lazy Song
songs.comments: Not sure if it's just my headphones but the percussive sounds are way to loud and stick out. Four repetitions of the chorus is a lot. The first and last are different I guess.
Lyrics are lighthearted and whimsical which matches with the song. The outro is great, background vocals especially feel like the missing piece.
songs.name: I'm Yours

songs.name: Tous les mêmes

songs.name: ゆめうつつ

songs.name: Payphone
You Make Me Real

songs.name: About Damn Time

About You

songs.comments: I cannot believe that this is the drummer singing. His voice is absolutely gorgeous.

Descendants Of The Sun Pt.3 (Original Television Soundtrack)

After The Storm (feat. Tyler, The Creator & Bootsy Collins)

songs.name: Blank Space

songs.name: Saliva
Honky Cat

songs.name: Walkin
Late Night Talking

songs.name: Here I Go Again - 2018 Remaster

93 Million Miles

songs.name: Only the Good Die Young

songs.name: Still into You

songs.name: Love On Top

Marry You

songs.name: American Boy

songs.name: Africa

Structure is pretty simplistic, just four verses with choruses between them. I didn't deduct from flow because the song is still dominated by distinct verses.
songs.name: Gorgeous
I Guess That's Why They Call It The Blues
Come A Little Bit Closer
songs.album: Come A Little Bit Closer: The Best Of Jay & The Americans

songs.comments: Maybe gets a little repetitive. I didn't deduct anything.
songs.name: New Face
If I Were a Boy

songs.name: R U Mine?
songs.comments: That guitar riff goes pretty hard honestly. The beginning is a bit trippy because it kind of baits you into thinking he's going to come in on a different beat than he does. I like the first verse though. The end of the bridge almost sounds like the outro.

songs.name: Mayonaka no Door / Stay With Me
Brandy (You're a Fine Girl)
songs.comments: I like that the lyrics have a story.

songs.name: Only Girl (In The World)
songs.comments: Interesting how the chorus shortens every time. The second chorus is the most confusing, where it goes from "one who understands" to "knows your heart." I kind just don't like how the song has three virtually identical peaks.

Vocals sound slightly flat. I don't love the structure, there's a short intro and outro and aside from that there are three sections that repeat once each in the same order. There's very little variance.
songs.name: 沉默是金

songs.comments: I like the theme of the song. Some of the lyrics sound a bit casual, but I suppose that fits with the overall feel of the song? The instrumental breaks are odd. The outro is a really cool concept though.
songs.name: World's Smallest Violin
X-Wing - Cold Blooded Soul Version

songs.comments: I really like his flow (lyrical flow and overall song flow are different). The background is actually pretty interesting too, some pretty unique chords there

songs.name: Money Trees
songs.comments: It sounds like Jay Rock drags a little in his verse. He takes a lot of breaths too. There just isn't a whole lot going on in the background. Rap songs are often like this though, it's just a track put on repeat.

songs.album: Around The World In A Day
songs.name: Raspberry Beret
My Type

Kind of repetitive. Vocals kind of stick out a bit. I don't really like the way the last line of the bridge was delivered.

songs.name: That's Life - 2008 Remastered
songs.comments: I really love how the last verse concludes the song.

songs.name: El Paso
songs.comments: The story drastically improves the flow of the song
Very repetitive lyrics. The scoop up at the end of "you" and "do" gets a little annoying when it's repeated that many times.

songs.name: Lost Boy

songs.album: Ladies And Gentlemen... The Best Of George Michael
songs.name: Careless Whisper

songs.comments: This song does a lot of things well but it just repeats the chorus too much in the second half. I really like the two unique verses at the beginning, especially the transition at the end of them into the chorus. I also generally like the energy of the song.
songs.name: Blow Me
Shut Up and Dance
songs.comments: The scraping noise on the right side is a bit odd towards the beginning. I love how faithfully the instrumental follows the vocals through the different sections. Chorus is a bit repetitive.
The bridge was what initially sold me on this song, it's very nice. The variation on the chorus at the end is also very well done. I might even consider upping the vocal score on this one
songs.name: Style
Hey Brother
songs.comments: Some pretty cool lyrics here in the first verse and the chorus. I don't like how the third verse just repurposes some previous lyrics. I don't like how they mess with the voice on the response lines like "Oh, brother." It sounds very hollow.

songs.name: Chonkyfire
songs.comments: The first verse into the first chorus is incredible. Then it kind of falls off. I just gave it 8's across the board thinking that the cool stuff cancels out the meh stuff
"The story of my life" gets repeated a LOT. Not too sure about the line "I spend her love until she's broke inside." It has an oddly negative connotation.
songs.name: Story of My Life

songs.comments: The videogame theme was cool, I wish it extended to the later verses. The climax maybe is a bit sudden, I guess that's the idea? He's a good singer but I feel his voice lacks some "purity" as some points. Partially the pitch correction probably.
songs.name: pacman
You Make My Dreams (Come True)
songs.comments: Pretty uninspiring structure. Not much motion throughout the song.

songs.name: Leave The Door Open
songs.comments: I feel a little bit like the song doesn't go anywhere but the instrumental is very interesting

Might just be the mixing but it feels like there's a hole in the lower sounds. Lyrics are brief, nothing wrong or special. Flow is actually good, the repeated verse at the end concludes lyrics well and the background wraps up beautifully.
songs.name: It's Been a Long, Long Time
California Dreamin' - Single Version
songs.album: If You Can Believe Your Eyes & Ears
What Do You Think About the Car?
songs.comments: Vocals are pretty unique. I like the instrumental. It's nice to see there's a real deeper message behind the lyrics.
songs.name: Brazil

songs.comments: Lyrics seem pretty nonsensical. Flow also seems pretty aimless.
songs.name: ALIEN

songs.comments: A lot of "It's Over"s. I think the song almost feels a little too happy for what it's talking about. Lyrics don't work well with the rest of the song but the vocals and background blend well.
songs.name: It's Over
Somebody That I Used To Know
songs.comments: I feel like the second half could have blended much better but the background vocals frequently started and stopped instead of being sustained.

He overpronounces words a little bit, the vocals generally have a strange timbre, probably because of the pitch correction. It's a little repetitive. Lyrics are also a bit basic, that could be lowered.
songs.name: Fine By Me

songs.album: The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess
songs.name: HOT TO GO!

songs.comments: This was a really difficult song to grade. Still don't really know how to approach it

songs.name: golden hour
Love Yourself
songs.comments: Not a huge fan of the ending. All of the unique verses seem to follow the exact same melody which just feels lazy.

songs.name: Back To You
songs.comments: Lyrics are pretty simplistic and repetitive.

songs.name: The Spins
songs.comments: The content of the lyrics doesn't match very well with the background. The song is a vibe though, it sounds like he was just messing around and having fun and that energy carries through. It's just disorganized and ends a bit strangely.

songs.name: 光の方へ
songs.comments: I love these vocals. Filled with emotion. The second chorus peaks much higher than the first. I don't know Japanese but the words sound good and the translation looks fine
I like the intro honestly. Love the bass. A little repetitive, especially from the bridge to the end.
songs.name: Treasure
I Don’t Wanna Live Forever (Fifty Shades Darker)
songs.album: reputation Stadium Tour Surprise Song Playlist
songs.comments: A bit strange how it builds up to a peak but then the "peak" is actually pretty low energy, and then the next section is a little higher energy? The run that ZAYN goes on in the last chorus sounds a little all over the place.

songs.name: Time in a Bottle
songs.album: You Don't Mess Around With Jim
songs.comments: This song is hard to grade because it's very solid but also very simple. That makes it difficult to raise any score even though lowering one would be out of the question.

songs.name: Another One Bites The Dust - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit all over the place. Riff is iconic but very little in the background aside from that. The bridge kind of kills that consistent pulse throughout the song. Cohesion is debatable, could go down.
Emotion in lyrics and background feels incongruent. Vocals are emotional and the background feels very "chill" and "vibey." The water sound is also a bit intrusive
songs.name: 애정결핍

songs.album: Song Request 신청곡 (feat. SUGA of BTS)
songs.name: Song Request 신청곡 (feat. SUGA of BTS)
songs.comments: The vocals almost have too much detail and are slightly too loud. Not a huge fan of the English lyrics but overall the lyrics are good. Not a big fan of the rap section. I like how the last verse calls back to the first.
Blends well. Lyrics fit with a consistent theme. I guess some of the wording in the lyrics is a bit pedestrian, could lower the score. The song has clear lows and highs giving it motion.
songs.name: Night Light

songs.comments: Quite repetitive.
songs.name: El Mismo Sol
Wildest Dreams
songs.comments: The variations and additional vocals in the last chorus were pretty nice.
I like how the sections have repeated formats but the phrases are changed. All the parts fit pretty nicely with the theme set by the lyrics. The background gives that kind of industrial vibe.
songs.name: Allentown

songs.comments: I like the lines starting with "a noise in the city" and "down on the corner." It is a little odd how it builds up to the chorus which then is rather low energy. Vocals are a mixed bag. Some lyrics are a little confusing in isolation, mostly in verse 3.
songs.name: Rain Is Falling

songs.comments: Vocals are a little too aggressive in the pre-chorus I feel, especially after the intro was very calm. It does feel a little odd how it peaks in the pre-chorus then goes down for the actual chorus? Background feels very basic.

songs.comments: Main criticisms, bridge is a bit random and the song is pretty repetitive. The lyrics are also feels a little random or generic. The song peaks really well.

songs.comments: "These are words that go together well" isn't a great line in my opinion. Lyrics get a little repetitive too. Flow score could go down but at least some of the words vary and the outro was pretty nice.

songs.comments: Structure isn't great. There are only two distinct sections, one is repeated three times. The delivery is changed slightly. The background interacts very well with the vocals. Score is a bit too high on this one.
songs.name: 最浪漫的事
songs.album: 我的愛 我的夢 我的家

songs.comments: I wish there were more unique verses man.

songs.comments: I like that there's a story in the lyrics. I like how the chorus lyrics change slightly to align with the story. The extra choruses at the end feel a little repetitive maybe.
songs.name: Escape (The Pina Colada Song)

songs.comments: The melody is very odd at the beginning and at several points throughout, I reflected that in the deduction to cohesion. I like the bass.
songs.name: Cherries Jubiles

songs.comments: Really unique melody. Vocals are a little unconventional, you would expect them to be a little more delicate considering the rest of the song. It kind of fits with the background though.
songs.name: Here With Me

songs.album: My Head Is An Animal (10th Anniversary Edition)
songs.comments: Lyrics are beautiful and haunting. I do almost feel like the last chorus went the wrong way maybe. I think it should've quietly died down instead of trying to climax. Strangely Spotify says the line is "dry as the walls" instead of "white as the walls."
songs.name: Sugar in a Bowl

songs.comments: Really nice riff. Credit where it's due, the line "there's only one carrot and they all gotta share it" is good. Having "runaway" in the name even though the song says "run away" is interesting. A bit repetitive and it just ends on another chorus.
songs.name: Runaway Baby
Belize (feat. MF DOOM)

songs.name: Stay With Me
Line Without a Hook
songs.comments: That "craving" stuck out a lot lol. His voice sounds a bit timid, which suits a lot of the song but not some of these aggressive entrances. Some strange choices for the melody at the bridge? I like that I can feel what he was going for.

songs.name: Leningrad

songs.name: Poker Face

songs.comments: Not sure if I like the vocals or not. The way he sings sounds lazy, which matches the laid back theme of the song, but also just sounds kind of grating. Bridge isn't great. Background is pretty basic. A bit repetitive.
songs.name: Young Dumb & Broke

songs.comments: The mix of hoarseness and desperation in the vocals is very unique. The lyrics are extremely repetitive.

songs.comments: I get that the lyrics are supposedly related to WW2 but some of the word choices aren't great. There's so much focus on the verses that the climax doesn't have lyrics which makes it feel less meaningful?

songs.comments: The lyrics just start repeating in the second half. Granted, the execution is different, but not having any new unique lyrics feels like a mistake. I debated on raising the background score, still not sure.
songs.album: Man On The Moon: The End Of Day

songs.name: All About That Bass
songs.comments: A surprisingly good song? Although the chorus repeats a lot, the execution varies and more parts are added throughout the song.

songs.comments: I don't like how it just repeats the earlier section and lines at the end. Everything before the chorus (the section where "blackbird fly" repeats) is really good.

songs.name: All I Ask Of You - From 'The Phantom Of The Opera' Motion Picture
songs.album: The Phantom Of The Opera (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)

songs.comments: Not personally a huge fan of this song but it does a lot of things right. The flow is great because of the theme of age and it also calls back to the beginning at the end. This also gives it a lot of unique lyrics. I'm probably underrating it because of my bias.
Seems like a lot of canto pop songs have the formula of slowly adding instruments to make the next chorus peak higher. Not the most revolutionary but definitely not bad.
songs.name: 紅豆

songs.comments: Some parts of the background are a little repetitive but overall it's good.

Misty

songs.name: Love On The Brain
songs.comments: Ending could've been better, it was a bit abrupt.

The quality of her voice is really good for this song. I admittedly don't like how much the chorus repeats. Some of the lyrics are good, others are a little corny.  It feels like there was the idea to have the song build a lot but it never got there.
songs.name: King
Cupid - Twin Version
songs.comments: Pretty solid song but maybe a bit basic? Words like "stupid" and "dumb" feel a bit pedestrian. Vocals would be a bit better without the slight accent. I like the bridge a lot. I do not like how the song ends suddenly after a repeated chorus.
Lyrics are pretty odd. Background score could arguably be raised, it was a pretty fire guitar solo.

Sunday Morning
songs.comments: Bridge is a little odd but it recovers well into the next section

songs.name: Forever - Single Version
songs.comments: Very short and simple in terms of flow and lyrics. I didn't want to lower lyric score since the song is so short anyway, but you could argue they repeat and are overly simplistic. I thought it was fine.

The bridge is incredible. Lyrics are mixed. Lines like "you want me to do it the same way as you," "I don't want anything," and "I don't want anyone" don't seem to fit with "I know you think of me when you think of her."
songs.name: The Adults Are Talking
arms
songs.comments: Cohesion score might be too high on this one

songs.name: Moneytalks
songs.comments: I thought he was saying "marry for the money" for some reason. The vocals fit very well with the crass, shallow theme in the lyrics. It definitely a little repetitive, especially because the bridge is short and similar to part of the chorus.
Lyrics are a little basic and cheesy. A few lines sound like they needed a few more syllables, like "for that night" and "needed you most." Instrumental is also pretty basic.
songs.name: Say You Won't Let Go

songs.comments: Lyrics are repetitive and don't contribute much. I personally don't mind the instrumental but it is pretty long.
songs.name: Light My Fire
days gone by

songs.name: Shake It Off
songs.comments: I do like how much "personality" this song has. Parts get added throughout the song which helps the flow. I could see an argument that the cohesion score should be raised.

songs.name: The Long And Winding Road - Remastered 2015

songs.comments: An intro and two choruses isn't great, but even just the short outro improves the flow a bit.

songs.name: 偏偏喜歡你
Serendipity
songs.comments: Lyrics are overall pretty solid on this one but I will mention that I don’t like when lyrics include a specific number of unknown significance like “twenty-three”

songs.name: Easy Ride
songs.comments: I like the song but it is a little confusing between some of the edgy and nonsensical lyrics and extremely upbeat instrumental. Structure is also a little weird with the repeated "the mask that you wore" section into an instrumental.

songs.name: Uptown Girl
songs.comments: The background vocals add a lot

songs.name: I Wish You Love
songs.comments: I don't really like the percussion in the background (clapping I think?). It feels a bit out of place to me and makes the song feel too casual

Happy - From "Despicable Me 2"

songs.name: Kiss

songs.name: Hello
songs.comments: The background builds throughout the song but it does generally feel very simplistic and underwhelming to me. A dedicated outro would've made this song much better.

songs.name: Paint It, Black
songs.comments: I feel that the low sections aren't sad enough and the high sections don't sound angry enough to match the story in the lyrics. Lyrics are a little edgy but understandably so given the setting. Sounds like the audio bugs a bit around the 2 minute mark.

songs.name: It's Still Rock and Roll to Me
Dernière danse
songs.comments: I don't like the kind of techno style that comes in at the second half. Her voice also sounds like it's being garbled by pitch correction.
Drums are pretty cool. I didn't like some of the vocals that sounded more "spoken" and a few of the sound effects. Generally the song feels very unique and interesting though.

songs.name: Love Me Two Times
songs.comments: Lyrics feel a bit nonsensical and repetitive

songs.name: Every Summertime
songs.comments: There are these little technical embellishments in the vocals that are alright but just sound a bit halfhearted. It makes them feel a bit confused. The chorus almost feels like a completely different song compared to the other verses.

songs.name: Faded
songs.comments: Definitely not my preferred music genre but I gotta admit it's pretty hype

songs.artists: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers
songs.name: Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers)
Not Like Us
songs.comments: For its purpose the lyrics were obviously effectively but outside of that context it kind of feels like I'm listening to a scuffle that I have no part in. Background is basic and repetitive.

songs.name: Truce
songs.comments: I find his voice a bit grating but you could argue it also has a lot of emotion.

There are a lot of lines that don't sound like they fit like "when everyone has gone" or "we love to try them on." I like the one starting with "some are satin" though. The verses all share a theme but their progression feels very random.
songs.name: The Stranger
L.A. Woman
songs.comments: The bridge is a bit odd but it leads well into the next section.
A lot of chorus but it changes at the end and I love the bridge.
songs.name: This Love
Roar

songs.name: Wet Dreamz
songs.comments: Funny story with a great twist. Background is repetitive. The story improves the flow.

songs.name: seasons
songs.comments: Not a fan of the second verse. Pronunciation isn't bad but vocals would be improved if it was better.

songs.name: Misery
songs.comments: I actually really liked the instrumental during the chorus. I think it's mostly the bass and the drums towards the end. I didn't really like the vocals on this one, they feel very unsubstantial during the unique verses. Some of the bridge is very odd.
Probably a bit harsh to deduct from vocals but they sound a bit awkward to me, the words feel stiff and forced. It's also a bit repetitive.
songs.name: California Gurls

songs.comments: I don't really like the pre-chorus, it feels a bit out of place with the rest of the song. I lowered flow a bit because of that combined with the chorus being a bit repetitive.
songs.name: My House
On Top Of The World
songs.comments: I absolutely love the transition into the bridge on this song.

songs.name: Dreamer's Ball - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: I really don't like the bridge. I think it completely ruins the vibe of the song for me as something very bittersweet. Aside from that I really like how the song sounds a bit confused on whether it's a bit more upbeat or melancholy. Kind of like denial?

songs.name: Good Life
songs.comments: Only criticism of the lyrics is that I think the last section at the end could've been its own unique verse instead of repeating the second verse.

Pretty repetitive chorus. Song also does give a feeling like it went nowhere. It ended pretty much where it started but because that was a repeated section it doesn't have the same impact as a callback.
songs.name: Feel It Still

songs.comments: I feel like I waited for the song to go somewhere but it never did. Vocals in the first verse were pretty impressive. Background is exceedingly bland.
songs.name: Dancing With A Stranger (with Normani)

songs.album: Songs In The Key Of Life
songs.comments: The song drags on a bit with the audio from what I assume is the birth of his child playing, which is also too loud.
songs.name: Isn't She Lovely

songs.album: At The Close Of A Century
songs.name: I Just Called To Say I Love You
songs.comments: I like how many distinct verses there are. It's also just cool how many different ways the song emphasizes that there's nothing special about the day. The two key changes are pretty cool too.
Crazy falsetto. I absolutely love the instrumental on this one but the score might be a bit high.
songs.name: Cool Cat - Remastered 2011
Rude
songs.comments: Pretty repetitive. The line "why you gotta be so rude" also just sounds a bit crude, which I suppose fits the character here, but still just isn't nice to listen to.

songs.name: Baby Blue - Remastered 2010
songs.comments: He cuts the phrases pretty short. I guess if they were too long it wouldn't fit with the high energy background? The lyrics definitely have a progression, kind of towards acceptance. Maybe a little too high energy for the lyrics.
The verses and the chorus almost feel like they're from completely different songs. It almost sounds like they're saying "I'll take my heart" instead of "attack my heart."
songs.name: Heart Attack (츄)

songs.comments: Could have benefitted from an outro in my opinion. The song is also just dominated by sections that get repeated.
songs.name: Mirrors - Radio Edit
Better When You're High

"The only thing that matters now is everything You think of me" is a terrifying line. It's pretty repetitive.
songs.name: You Say

songs.comments: A very good example of building throughout the song and changing the delivery on the same lyric

songs.comments: Background vocals do a lot for this song
songs.name: Wouldn't It Be Nice
Footloose

Did they just invent the phrase "I'm not into bacon?" Lyrics are kind of hilarious but the character is supposed to be upset. Song is very upbeat? Bridge is great.
songs.name: I Found A Girl
Sit Still, Look Pretty
songs.comments: The vocals sound a little garbled in the distinct verses. It's quite repetitive. Not a fan of the Snow White line, it feels petty and the message of that story doesn't seem very similar to the one in this song.

songs.name: 24K Magic
songs.comments: Difficult song to grade. I kind of just don't like repeated sections. Maybe it's because of the energy level of the song but I feel like even one direct repetition has me wonder a bit why I'm listening to the same thing again.
I like the lyrics in the first two verses a lot. The vocals very dynamic which makes the lyrics feel less repetitive, especially in the outro.
songs.album: A Day At The Races (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.name: Somebody To Love - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: The vocals are excellent but they do stick out a little bit. I actually love the background vocals in the outro.
songs.name: Who's Lovin' You
Here Comes The Sun - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: Lyrics are a little simplistic. Maybe a bit too much repetition of certain words, even in the unique verses, but generally lyrics are solid. The song doesn't really go anywhere at the end unfortunately.

songs.name: Captain Jack
songs.comments: I don't like how the song was made to insult people, even if they are rich and spoiled. I always heard the chorus as someone getting a rush of happiness from some substance in their otherwise miserable life. I guess that's kind of correct?

songs.name: Paradise City
songs.comments: Pretty repetitive. The structure with all the instrumental breaks is also odd. The vocals feel lacking in control during lower energy sections but they fit extremely well when energy is high.

songs.album: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons
songs.name: Can't Take My Eyes off You
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit repetitive but good

songs.name: Don't Ask Me Why
songs.comments: Flow score reduced because I feel like the bridge doesn't fit perfectly and because the song keeps the same format until the last verse
I promise the lyrics aren't transphobic. Still, they're a bit awkward and repetitive.
songs.name: Dude (Looks Like A Lady)

songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.comments: Some lyrics like "Emerald Bar" are a bit random. It's a story about a character but the song is too short to flesh it out. I do like the simplicity of the chorus lyrics and lines like "you've got not real ambition" though.
songs.name: Spread Your Wings - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: Some of the lyrics are definitely a little funny, like "obsessed with your body" and "ten times nightly." Also the bridge just repeating the same line.
songs.name: Sweet
Tell Her About It
songs.comments: I like the theme of the lyrics being advice. There are a lot of unique lines.

songs.name: Bohemian Rhapsody
songs.comments: This song is all over the place. The third verse and bridge are completely different and the lyrics are more nonsensical. I do like how it returns to the same theme as the first half at the end though. Scoring on this one is very questionable.

songs.name: a thousand years

I was bit on the fence about vocals lyrics and flow here. Vocals are solid but nothing really pops out. Some words and phrases are repetitive and the song stays at the same energy level throughout.
Pretty uninspiring structure. Not much motion throughout the song.
The execution almost sounds too clean for the vibe of the song
Lyrics are very simple. Nothing to dislike that much I guess. Funnily enough the one part I feel is a bit out of place is line the song is named after.
I keep hearing "que paso" at the start of the chorus
Emotion in lyrics and background feels incongruent. Vocals are emotional and the background feels very "chill" and "vibey." The water sound is also a bit intrusive

logs.songName: テレフォン・ナンバー
logs.comments: Had to deduct a bit for the lyrics. 56709 is repeated a lot and it's just not a great lyric. Still kind of works though
I love these vocals. Filled with emotion. The second chorus peaks much higher than the first. I don't know Japanese but the words sound good and the translation looks fine
Vocals are unpolished but have a lot of emotion. The song is very repetitive though.
Vocals are unpolished but have a lot of emotion. The song is very repetitive though.
The background does build. I still would've preferred some new lyrics and a bit more of a climax.
I do like how the instruments come in during the second half, and how the song concludes the way it started.

logs.songName: 浪子心聲 - 電影《半斤八両》歌曲
logs.comments: Gorgeous instrumental, blends beautifully. Lyrics read like a poem.
The background builds a bit. You could argue the background score should be higher.
Seems like a lot of canto pop songs have the formula of slowly adding instruments to make the next chorus peak higher. Not the most revolutionary but definitely not bad.
Gorgeous background. Creates such powerful emotions. Clear lows and highs throughout. Maybe a slight criticism that the low high low high low high low high pattern can start to wear a bit.

I really like this song. I like it more than the score I gave it. Her style is just so odd to grade because her singing is off key but it seems intentional. Even so, in parts like the second chorus it just sounds off-putting.
The song clearly builds throughout. Some really nice lyrics in here like "this all-consuming fire fuming" but also some weaker ones like "what's going on" which doesn't sound right.
Definitely one of my favorite background instrumentals

My favorite song. I think it sounds much better when you turn up the volume, otherwise you can't hear all the details in the background. The song has obvious climaxes and the second chorus peaks higher than the first.
The peak in the second verse is incredible. Main criticism is how often the chorus repeats, especially at the end. Just not a very strong ending.
The bass does a lot for this song. The parts all fit well with the upbeat theme. Very repetitive stuff though, the refrain, pre-chorus, chorus and post-chorus all are almost one to one.
logs.songName: CAN'T STOP THE FEELING! (from DreamWorks Animation's "TROLLS")

logs.comments: Cohesion score might be too high on this one

I can't understand the lyrics but I like how all the sections are distinct. The translated lyrics also seem very sad and sweet. I like how the song transitions into "if she comes back" and that the outro calls back to the prior phrase
Crazy falsetto. I absolutely love the instrumental on this one but the score might be a bit high.
Crazy falsetto. I absolutely love the instrumental on this one but the score might be a bit high.

"My favorite song. I think it sounds much better when you turn up the volume, otherwise you can't hear all the details in the background. The song has obvious climaxes and the second chorus peaks higher than the first. "
Background grows throughout. I don't like the line "that's what friends are s'posed to do" line but the lyrics overall are solid.

Putting different parts on different sides has an interesting effect but it does feel a bit lacking in the left ear. The lyrics sound poetic but are a bit nonsensical. I'm tempted to increase the vocal score because his voice has such a unique quality.

I feel that the "ooh, baby, baby" kind of breaks the flow a bit and the transition into the instrumental was a bit random but the song moves smoothly mostly. Instrumental on this song is amazing and everything fits together well.
The lyrics on this one are a bit basic. "You're a teaser you turn 'em on" is a bit of a clunky line. Arguably could be decreased.
Cohesion score might be too high on this one
The piano accompaniment fits really well with the vocals. Vocals feel very free and unleashed. Lyrics fit well with the theme but can be a little silly and they repeat.
Unreal vocals. I think the key change stuff at the end is interesting but it gets a little repetitive and the fade out ending feels lazy
The first half flows really well with the two unique verses but it repeats the post chorus too many times at the end I feel.

I really don't like the bridge. I think it completely ruins the vibe of the song for me as something very bittersweet. Aside from that I really like how the song sounds a bit confused on whether it's a bit more upbeat or melancholy. Kind of like denial?
Really beautiful lyrics in the context that they're about his mother's death. The way the chorus is delivered is different each time.
A lot of unique lyrics. One of the few ELO songs where the vocals are really highlighted. There's clearly a flow in the lyrics with this "voyage." The song has clear lows and highs.

Very short and simple in terms of flow and lyrics. I didn't want to lower lyric score since the song is so short anyway, but you could argue they repeat and are overly simplistic. I thought it was fine.

Lyrics are a mixed bag. I don't really like "case of fragile glass," I think it's too direct. "A year and forty days since you picked me up and swept me away" is very specific and the rhyming feels tacky.
Lyrics are a bit repetitive but the delivery is different.
That last crazy turn at the end sounded a bit out of control to me. I feel like the instrumental is lacking a bit of percussion. Lyrics sound good but they are a bit repetitive.
Lyrics are lighthearted and whimsical which matches with the song. The outro is great, background vocals especially feel like the missing piece.

logs.songName: It's Been a Long, Long Time
logs.comments: Might just be the mixing but it feels like there's a hole in the lower sounds. Lyrics are brief, nothing wrong or special. Flow is actually good, the repeated verse at the end concludes lyrics well and the background wraps up beautifully.

logs.songName: I Want To Break Free - Remastered 2011
logs.comments: Unsure if I like how different the feeling of the lyrics are from the vocals or not, it definitely has its charm. The distinct verses definitely indicate flow over time of getting over someone. Very conflicted over scores for almost every category here.

The quality of her voice is really good for this song. I admittedly don't like how much the chorus repeats. Some of the lyrics are good, others are a little corny.  It feels like there was the idea to have the song build a lot but it never got there.
I wish there were more unique verses man.

Vocals are a little odd, might be an acquired taste. Background is uninspiring for most of the song except for the bridge. You could argue all the parts fit together with the theme? Overall, a very weird song to grade, very unconventional.
The back and forth conversation is cool. The lyrics indicate a flow a time with an event happening at the bridge.
The parts blend well. You can feel that the song has a direction as it rises and falls.

The whole song has this slurred grungy feeling that really feels like the vibe of a stumbling drunk. The emotions reach their peak by the fourth verse. Lyrics are a little all over the place. I guess that also fits with the rest of the song.

Vocals feel very technical. Really nice lyrics, as expected since it's a jazz standard. The song has a rising and falling motion. Nothing special about cohesion I don't think, the background mostly is just getting out of the way of the vocals.
Love the instrumental. A lot of chorus but the delivery does vary a bit. I really like the verse with "how can you stay."

I'm a little biased with this song admittedly. I really like the line starting with "you reach your hand to hold me." The energy of the song increases throughout. One of the best implementations of having different parts in different ears.
Blends well. Lyrics fit with a consistent theme. I guess some of the wording in the lyrics is a bit pedestrian, could lower the score. The song has clear lows and highs giving it motion.
Shocking good vocals, very technical. Pretty disastrous lyrics. Repetitive, boring and crude. Flow is actually pretty cool with the extra parts coming in later in the song.
Background vocals are a bit too aggressive in my opinion. I like the consistency each verse has with the river theme. They are iterate upon it a bit. Lyrics follow a similar structure and theme.

The sounds in the background (synth?) together with the background vocals give it a mellow "spacey" sound that fits with the theme. I like how it switches between isolating his vocals and blending with the full background. Gives it a lonely sound.
logs.songName: Rocket Man (I Think It's Going To Be A Long, Long Time)

logs.comments: I really like the lines "Come back and haunt me" and "do not speak as loud as my heart." The song builds upwards throughout.

I like how the final "anyway" calls back to the one from the end of the first verse. Good example of varying repetitions, the second chorus has a lot more energy than the first. The song has some direction as it flares up then dies down.
The song has a kind of "fuzzy" sound that makes you feel the idea of something stumbling around in a haze. The outro calls back to the first verse which is nice.

Some lyrics like "Emerald Bar" are a bit random. It's a story about a character but the song is too short to flesh it out. I do like the simplicity of the chorus lyrics and lines like "you've got not real ambition" though.

Mikky's vocals sound a little tense. I actually like the way the chorus differs each time it comes. It swaps singers for the second chorus and Rhianna adds a spectacular embellishment to the final one for the outro.

Background vocals are really nice when you listen closely. Incredible lyrics in the unique verses and the bridge. I think there's at least one additional part every time the chorus comes back as well.
logs.songName: Take Me Home, Country Roads - Original Version

logs.comments: Not a huge fan of Earl Sweatshirt's verse. The verse with the "I'm on that ledge" line is really good. Lyrics are consistent with a theme that also has a bit of a story which gives it good flow.
Not a huge fan of Earl Sweatshirt's verse. The verse with the "I'm on that ledge" line is really good. Lyrics are consistent with a theme that also has a bit of a story which gives it good flow.

Mikky's vocals sound a little tense. I actually like the way the chorus differs each time it comes. It swaps singers for the second chorus and Rhianna adds a spectacular embellishment to the final one for the outro.

Third verse indicates time passing which helps flow. I think the final chorus would've been better if it was more unique. Arguably could lower vocal score, it's not the most impressive performance but I like the emotion.

The vocals have a sound (an echo?) that makes them feel so lonely. Incredibly iconic piano riff. The first time the pre-chorus comes is amazing, it's a great transition into the higher energy section. I wish the second half didn't repeat so much stuff.

The vocals have a sound (an echo?) that makes them feel so lonely. Incredibly iconic piano riff. The first time the pre-chorus comes is amazing, it's a great transition into the higher energy section. I wish the second half didn't repeat so much stuff.
Chorus makes up too much of the song I feel. The timbre of his voice is incredible though. It blends well with the background vocals and the guitar.
Some good lyrics, others a bit awkward or cheesy. Too much chorus. Instrumental is very cool.
I like the lyrics in the first two verses a lot. The vocals very dynamic which makes the lyrics feel less repetitive, especially in the outro.

The lyrics just start repeating in the second half. Granted, the execution is different, but not having any new unique lyrics feels like a mistake. I debated on raising the background score, still not sure.
I like the way the parts blend. I also quite like the flow of the song, the transitions from the instrumental sections to the vocal sections is nice.

I'm not a huge fan of the guitar solo, it feels a bit out of place with the other instruments and the rest of the song. The lyrics sound good and the translation seems good. The final chorus peaks the highest and adds more parts which helps the flow.
The reversed vocals at the bridge is a little tacky. The chorus repeats a lot but some of the lyrics are also pretty nice so it about evens out. Vocals in the final chorus are absolutely gorgeous.
Beautiful story in the lyrics that has a clear flow of time.

logs.songName: When She Loved Me - From "Toy Story 2" / Soundtrack Version
logs.comments: Beautiful story in the lyrics that has a clear flow of time.

Four distinct verses and each one has lyrics that express powerful feelings of grief and sorrow. A lot of chorus admittedly. There are ups and downs in the song but overall it climbs to the climax in the outro. The percussion in the background is great.

Lyrics are beautiful and haunting. I do almost feel like the last chorus went the wrong way maybe. I think it should've quietly died down instead of trying to climax. Strangely Spotify says the line is "dry as the walls" instead of "white as the walls."
The vocals carry a lot of emotion. Lyrics are beautiful. Small criticism, the transition from "wish you were here" to "we're just two lost souls" is a bit awkward.

Background vocals are really nice when you listen closely. Incredible lyrics in the unique verses and the bridge. I think there's at least one additional part every time the chorus comes back as well.
logs.songName: Take Me Home, Country Roads - Original Version

logs.comments: The background is unbelievably repetitive which also makes the song a bit repetitive despite the changing lyrics
Very little variation in the lyrics
Not a fan of the line "as the atom bomb locks in" but a lot of the other lyrics are nice.
I like the first section a lot more than the rest
All the parts fit together well with the theme of the song. Some of the sections feel a bit odd or exhausting though because it's a very a long song so I reduced the flow.
Flow score reduced because I feel like the bridge doesn't fit perfectly and because the song keeps the same format until the last verse

Difficult song to grade. I kind of just don't like repeated sections. Maybe it's because of the energy level of the song but I feel like even one direct repetition has me wonder a bit why I'm listening to the same thing again.

Not personally a huge fan of this song but it does a lot of things right. The flow is great because of the theme of age and it also calls back to the beginning at the end. This also gives it a lot of unique lyrics. I'm probably underrating it because of my bias.
A surprisingly good song? Although the chorus repeats a lot, the execution varies and more parts are added throughout the song.
First verse has good lyrics but most of the rest are repetitive and mediocre. Nothing too wrong with the vocals but they're just a bit boring. Instrument break and the bridge feel a bit out of place.
Juxtaposition between the two section is pretty cool. It does mess with the flow a little bit though, makes the song feel kind of choppy.
A bit repetitive.
Lyrics generally aren't saying anything, there are also a lot of words relating to the movie. Some cool riffs in the background but also quite repetitive.
logs.artists: Metro Boomin, Swae Lee, Lil Wayne, Offset
